verses.2: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
verses.3: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
verses.4: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
verses.5: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

verses.11: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
verses.12: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
verses.14: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
verses.16: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
verses.17: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
verses.18: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

verses.22: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
verses.23: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
verses.25: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
verses.26: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
verses.28: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
verses.29: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
verses.31: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.32: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
verses.33: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
verses.35: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

verses.38: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

verses.40: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

verses.42: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
